kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
نعتكد (form VIII)
# نَعْتَكِدُ (naʕtakidu) /naʕ.ta.ki.du/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِعْتَكَدَ (iʕtakada)
# نُعْتَكَدُ (nuʕtakadu) /nuʕ.ta.ka.du/: first-person plural non-past passive indicative of اِعْتَكَدَ (iʕtakada)
# نَعْتَكِدَ (naʕtakida) /naʕ.ta.ki.da/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِعْتَكَدَ (iʕtakada)
# نُعْتَكَدَ (nuʕtakada) /nuʕ.ta.ka.da/:
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
